CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Figma (NYSE: FIG) is where teams come together to turn ideas into the world's best digital products and experiences. Founded in 2012, Figma has evolved from a design tool to a connected, AI-powered platform that helps teams go from idea to shipped product. Whether you're ideating, designing, building, or shipping, Figma makes the entire design and product development process more collaborative, efficient, and fun-while keeping everyone on the same page.
